scientific_integrity: The universal all-tree recurrence follows by local coverage and induction. Finite direct-function and coverage-state enumerations are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty unordered rooted trees; exactly one reflexive-descendant relation. Complexity counts big-integer operations, with exponential dependence on target branching. No claim for general DAGs, unbounded bit complexity, or unseen historical priority.
title: Exact bounded-morphism counting between arbitrary finite rooted tree frames
